---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the problem or limitation you're running into. Ex.
"I can't tell at a glance which Batteries in a Set are due for a charge."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd want to happen instead.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

**Is this in scope for this app?**
Battery Tracker is intentionally local-only and offline-first (see
`README.md`) — features that require an account, a server, or cloud sync
are out of scope by design. If your request depends on one of those, say so
and we can discuss whether there's a local-only way to achieve the same
goal.

**Additional context**
Mockups, examples from other apps, or anything else that helps explain the
request.
